style.vernacular: Small Bermudian-founded salt-trade town on a low, hot semi-arid limestone island: one and two-storey houses and guesthouses of local limestone or painted render with timber verandas, shutters and tin roofs, pastel cream, yellow, turquoise and white, facing Front Street and the sea; newer government and commercial blocks are plain flat or hipped-roof painted concrete.
style.ornament: Bermudian-style upper and lower timber verandas with turned posts and railings, louvred shutters, steps up to the front door, old iron street lamps along Duke and Front Streets, low limestone garden walls.
